# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 11 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 11

**11:1** She took up the water jar and went out to draw water. And behold, a voice came to her: "Rejoice, favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women."

**11:2** She looked to the right and to the left to find where the voice was coming from. Trembling, she returned to her house, set down the jar, picked up the purple thread, sat down in her chair, and resumed spinning.

**11:3** Then an angel of the Lord appeared and stood before her, saying: "Do not be afraid, Mary. You have found favor before the Lord of all. You shall conceive by his word."

**11:4** She heard this and began reasoning to herself: "Shall I conceive from the Lord God who lives, and give birth as every woman gives birth?"

**11:5** The angel of the Lord said to her: "Not in that way, Mary. For the power of the Lord shall overshadow you. Therefore the holy one who is born of you shall be called the Son of the Most High. And you shall name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."

**11:6** And Mary said: "Behold the handmaid of the Lord before him. Let it be done to me according to your word."
